body.name: Explicit tilted product prior and induced target
body.construction: \(\mathcal T_{\mathrm{tilt}}=[-\|s\|_\infty^{-1},\|s\|_\infty^{-1}]\). For each \(t\in\mathcal T_{\mathrm{tilt}}\), \(\pi_t=\bigotimes_{l=1}^L\pi_{t,l}\), where \(\pi_{t,l}\{V_l=1/2\}=(1+ts_l)/2\) and \(\pi_{t,l}\{V_l=-1/2\}=(1-ts_l)/2\). Hence every coordinate probability lies in \([0,1]\), and the induced target functional is \(\tau_t=\mathbb E_{\pi_t}[T(V)]=(t/2)\sum_{l=1}^Lw_ls_l=t\sqrt S/2\).
